summary: Node agent: installing or updating the Ardent package failed on an owner account without the install prefix's parent directory (for example a fresh account without ~/.local/share), because the private staging directory beside the prefix was created without -p. The agent now creates each missing parent inside the owner home as the owner, one level at a time with mode 0700, refuses a parent that resolves outside the home, and still creates the staging directory itself without -p. No migrations and no new settings. Only the agent changed; either side can go first.
